title: PlanBench: An Extensible Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on Planning and Reasoning about Change
reasoning: The paper introduces a new benchmark (PlanBench) for evaluating LLMs on planning and reasoning about actions and change. While it references related work that includes 'ethical reasoning', its own benchmark is not designed to evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics. The 'Broader Impact' section also clarifies that PlanBench does not contain personally-identifiable or privacy-related information and is intended to measure planning capabilities.
